Metadata.title: Rango 90 — Football challenges
Metadata.description: Football challenges based on historical rankings.

HomePage.lead: Rank legends, clubs and national teams. The fewer points, the better.
HomePage.footer: The competition starts with a ranking.

offline.banner: Offline: the cached experience is available, but online games and results will wait for the connection to return.

home.title: Choose badly. Learn fast.
home.description: Assign each name to the category where it can land lowest. The historical table decides the score.

principle.copy: The lower the rank, the less it weighs on your result.

game.entityPrompt: Choose the category that leaves them best placed.

feedback.label: Play result
feedback.pendingCopy: The server calculates the official position when the game closes.

complete.label: Challenge complete
complete.title: Every slot has an owner.
complete.copy: You placed all seven items before the clock ran out. Check your final result.

timeout.label: Time is up
timeout.title: Remaining slots weigh 100.
timeout.copy: The clock has finished. Unused categories receive the maximum penalty.

abandoned.label: Challenge abandoned
abandoned.title: This attempt is out.
abandoned.copy: Return home or start a new challenge.

error.title: The table did not load.
error.copy: The challenge could not be prepared. You can try again.
error.noChallenge: No daily challenge has been published yet. Try again later.

result.title: Your table is served.
result.subtitle: Every decision leaves a mark. Try again with another combination.
result.duelSubtitle: The server has closed your result. See how it compares with your rival.
result.shareError: The result could not be shared.
result.duplicate: Result was already saved; the official response is preserved.
result.savedGuest: Result saved as guest; it is not added to the leaderboard.
result.savedNotQualified: Result saved; it is outside the leaderboard cut.
result.saveError: The result could not be saved.
result.waitingOpponent: Your rival has not finished yet.

ranking.title: The table is ruthless.
ranking.subtitle: Your best score of the day is shown. Lower is better.
ranking.error: The leaderboard could not be loaded.

duels.title: Same board. Two reads.
duels.subtitle: Share a link and each person plays the same challenge once.
duels.cardCopy: A rematch opens a new duel. This board cannot be replayed.
duels.invalid: That duel link does not exist.
duels.notJoinable: This duel no longer accepts participants.
duels.participantExists: You already have a game in this duel.
duels.active: Your rival may still be playing.
duels.sessionExpired: Your duel session expired. Open the link to continue if it is still available.
duels.unavailable: The duel could not be reached.
duels.note: The same published challenge is preserved for both participants.

status.open: Duel open: waiting for a rival.

account.title: Your name on the table.
account.subtitle: Play as a guest or create an account to save results and compete.
account.guestCopy: Your current progress can be linked to a verified account.

info.title: Every category has a rule.
info.subtitle: Definitions and labels load from the published challenge.

auth.title: Your identity on the table.
auth.subtitle: Create an account or sign in to save results and appear on the leaderboard.
auth.switchToLogin: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.verificationRequired: Signed in. Check your email to verify the account.
auth.note: Guest results do not appear on the leaderboard.

errors.generic: The operation could not be completed.
errors.offline: The backend is unavailable. Check the connection and try again.
errors.auth: You need to sign in to continue.
errors.session: The game session has expired. Start again.
errors.not_found: The requested challenge was not found.
errors.conflict: The operation is no longer valid for this state.
errors.server: The server had a temporary problem.
